basics.name: Dariusz Andrzej Wójcik
basics.label: Research Fellow (Post-doc)
basics.summary: Applied Mathematician and Space Physicist with expertise in turbulence, stochastic processes, probability theory, and space data analysis. Experienced in working with the NASA Magnetospheric Multiscale (MMS) mission satellite data, statistical modeling, numerical analysis, and interdisciplinary research bridging mathematics and space physics, as well as finances and insurances. Proficient in applying advanced mathematical frameworks such as Markov processes, Fokker–Planck dynamics, and multifractal analysis to investigate energy transfer mechanisms in space plasma turbulence across kinetic scales. Author of various peer-reviewed publications in leading physical and astrophysical journals.

projects.name: Turbulence and Magnetic Reconnection in Earth’s Space Environment
projects.summary: Data analysis on very small scales acquired from various space missions in the neighborhood of the Earth in space. With unprecedented high resolution of MMS observations in the solar wind and the magnetosphere this allows us to grasp the mechanisms driving magnetic reconnection, leading to a better description of space plasmas within kinetic theory.
